ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; approximately 94% low-intensity (dark) pixels with 6% high-intensity (white) linear features.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, obtuse U-shaped depression estimated at 145 degrees; vertical notch depth is roughly 8% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Frequent, irregular micro-serrations with a pixel amplitude of 2-5 pixels along the trailing boundary, particularly pronounced on the distal sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve at the lateral tips transitioning to a concave sweep toward the medial notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Occasional circular high-intensity pixel clusters (< 5 pixels in diameter) observed primarily at the posterior-lateral margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of multi-directional, unaligned high-contrast linear streaks (rake marks) visible across the entire ventral surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive accumulation of white linear scars across the dark integument, likely from tooth-rake interactions.
